newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia barley sales to Saudi gather pace.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia barley sales to Saudi gather pace.

text.p: Australia's shipments of barley to Saudi Arabia for January delivery were likely to total 100,000 tonnes to 150,000 tonnes in deals struck at US$130.00-$133.00 a tonne fob, market sources said.
But trade reports that three 35,000 tonnes to 40,000 tonnes had been done for January arrival from southern western and eastern Australia were based on speculation, they said.

Market sources said Western Australia was likely to supply barley as part of Saudi Arabia's latest purchase of 500,000 tonnes. But deals had not been done from eastern Australia "at this stage", they said.
A spokesman for the Grains Pool of Western Australia declined to comment, saying that sales were confidential and the state still had a lot of barley to move.
The spokesman also described reports of the January deliveries to Saudi Arabia from southern, western and eastern Australia as speculative, but declined to elaborate.
"We'll have to leave the rumour floating about," he said.
New South Wales has a ship loading barley in the next few days for December delivery, a market source said.
